mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition defined as unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals potential economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS (both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% monthly growth), supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate profit margins expand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO growth signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer confidence and residential investment, consistently driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting delayed Federal Reserve rate cuts and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and reduced corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS (rising) and UNRATE (falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS signal in high-rate regimes is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
